summary: Iteration 16: Security Fixes Verification - ALL TESTS PASSED. critical_code_review_comments: Security fixes properly implemented: require_admin() helper enforces 403 for non-admin users
JWT_SECRET is now a strong 128-character hex string
get_user_from_request() reads user data from DB, not from token payload
Rate limiter uses in-memory collections.defaultdict - will reset on server restart
CORS origins configurable via ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var
